rubric.measured: 90–100. An exact regional Azure Retail Prices meter or a validated Databricks price-card/calculator USD/DBU row.
rubric.conflict: 0. Unreconciled first-party values for the same price key; the qualified quote is withheld.
rubric.cited: 70–89. A first-party number in the docs.
rubric.secondary: 40–69. A bundled secondary compilation without a matching captured first-party rate.
rubric.proxy: 20–39. A real rate for a different SKU or region, scaled. Lakehouse Real-Time factors are this band.
rubric.unpublished: 0–19. No dollar rate is stored. The zero is not a guess.
